7534.title: Retired desktop generations leave browser cleanup retrying indefinitely
7534.rootCauseOneLine: Cleanup reloads the saved desktop generation on every close, while broker routing rejects retired generations and finish preserves cleanupPending with another retry instruction.
7534.proposedFix: Define an explicit terminal disposition for retired generations before altering cleanup. Preserve generation and lease ownership checks; do not blindly replay old tab IDs against a replacement generation.
7534.caveats: The server cleanup loop is reproduced twice through the existing plugin harness; desktop RPCs are simulated. Actual host-broker generation rejection passes in both checkouts. No live Electron reconnect or original-resource inspection was performed. No safe simple fix was established without choosing cross-generation ownership/retirement policy.
